outcome: DNA methylation in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 429 non-smoking mother-infant pairs from Colorado, USA.
finding: Differentially methylated regions in cord blood were associated with maternal exposure to PM2.5 and O3, but there was limited and statistically non-significant evidence of mediation by DNA methylation of the association between third trimester O3 exposure and 5-month infant adiposity.
